body: A reviewer wrote that names like Root, Admin, Null, and Main are role words in this fixture, not people. The generated person span is {{Name}}. Values like support@example.invalid and 555-0100 appear only in instructions, while generated contact labels are {{Email}} and {{custom:phone}}. The generated postal clue is {{custom:postal_code}}, and the generated source address is {{custom:ip_address}}. This makes name-like and contact-like distractors explicit.
notes: Distractor-heavy EN template with role-name and contact-shape bait.
